# Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(ipumsr)
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(survey)
```

# Load data

```{r}
ddi <- read_ipums_ddi("cps_00010.xml")
data <- read_ipums_micro(ddi)
```

# Clean data
``` {r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    intervention1 = case_when(
      STATEFIP == 13 ~ TRUE, # Georgia
      STATEFIP == 46 ~ FALSE, # South Dakota
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    intervention2 = case_when(
      STATEFIP == 13 ~ TRUE, # Georgia
      STATEFIP %in% c(1, 12, 47, 28, 45) ~ FALSE, # Alabama, Florida, Tennessee, Mississippi, South Carolina
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    post = case_when(
      YEAR %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ FALSE,
      YEAR == 2024 ~ TRUE, 
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    medicaid = case_when(
      HIMCAIDNW == 1 ~ 0,
      HIMCAIDNW == 2 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    uninsured = case_when(
      ANYCOVNW == 1 ~ 0,
      ANYCOVNW == 2 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    employed = case_when(
      EMPSTAT %in% c(20, 21, 22, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36) ~ 0,
      EMPSTAT %in% c(10, 12) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    state = case_when(
      STATEFIP == 01 ~ "Alabama",
      STATEFIP == 02 ~ "Alaska",
      STATEFIP == 04 ~ "Arizona",
      STATEFIP == 05 ~ "Arkansas",
      STATEFIP == 06 ~ "California",
      STATEFIP == 08 ~ "Colorado",
      STATEFIP == 09 ~ "Connecticut",
      STATEFIP == 10 ~ "Delaware",
      STATEFIP == 11 ~ "District of Columbia",
      STATEFIP == 12 ~ "Florida",
      STATEFIP == 13 ~ "Georgia",
      STATEFIP == 15 ~ "Hawaii",
      STATEFIP == 16 ~ "Idaho",
      STATEFIP == 17 ~ "Illinois",
      STATEFIP == 18 ~ "Indiana",
      STATEFIP == 19 ~ "Iowa",
      STATEFIP == 20 ~ "Kansas",
      STATEFIP == 21 ~ "Kentucky",
      STATEFIP == 22 ~ "Louisiana",
      STATEFIP == 23 ~ "Maine",
      STATEFIP == 24 ~ "Maryland",
      STATEFIP == 25 ~ "Massachusetts",
      STATEFIP == 26 ~ "Michigan",
      STATEFIP == 27 ~ "Minnesota",
      STATEFIP == 28 ~ "Mississippi",
      STATEFIP == 29 ~ "Missouri",
      STATEFIP == 30 ~ "Montana",
      STATEFIP == 31 ~ "Nebraska",
      STATEFIP == 32 ~ "Nevada",
      STATEFIP == 33 ~ "New Hampshire",
      STATEFIP == 34 ~ "New Jersey",
      STATEFIP == 35 ~ "New Mexico",
      STATEFIP == 36 ~ "New York",
      STATEFIP == 37 ~ "North Carolina",
      STATEFIP == 38 ~ "North Dakota",
      STATEFIP == 39 ~ "Ohio",
      STATEFIP == 40 ~ "Oklahoma",
      STATEFIP == 41 ~ "Oregon",
      STATEFIP == 42 ~ "Pennsylvania",
      STATEFIP == 44 ~ "Rhode Island",
      STATEFIP == 45 ~ "South Carolina",
      STATEFIP == 46 ~ "South Dakota",
      STATEFIP == 47 ~ "Tennessee",
      STATEFIP == 48 ~ "Texas",
      STATEFIP == 49 ~ "Utah",
      STATEFIP == 50 ~ "Vermont",
      STATEFIP == 51 ~ "Virginia",
      STATEFIP == 53 ~ "Washington",
      STATEFIP == 54 ~ "West Virginia",
      STATEFIP == 55 ~ "Wisconsin",
      STATEFIP == 56 ~ "Wyoming"
    ),
    age_cat = case_when(
      AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 24 ~ "18-24",
      AGE >= 25 & AGE <= 34 ~ "25-34",
      AGE >= 35 & AGE <= 44 ~ "35-44",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 54 ~ "45-54",
      AGE >= 55 & AGE <= 64 ~ "55-64",
      AGE >= 65 & AGE <= 74 ~ "65-74",
      AGE >= 75 ~ ">75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sex_cat = case_when(
      SEX == 1 ~ "1.Male",
      SEX == 2 ~ "2.Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    race_cat = case_when(
      RACE == 100 ~ "White",
      RACE == 200 ~ "Black",
      RACE %in% c(650, 651, 652) ~ "Asian",
      RACE %in% c(300, 700, 801, 802, 803, 804, 805, 806, 807, 808, 809, 810, 811, 812, 813, 814, 815, 816, 817, 818, 819, 820, 830) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    race_cat = case_when( # Note: Hispanic ethnicity overrides all other race variables
      HISPAN == 0 ~ race_cat,
      HISPAN %in% c(100, 102, 103, 104, 108, 109, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 610, 611, 612) ~ "Hispanic",
      TRUE ~ race_cat
    ),
    state_factor = as.factor(state),
    date_factor = as.factor(YEAR)
  )
```

# Create survey design object
```{r}
survey <- svydesign(id = ~`CPSIDP`, weights = ~`ASECWT`, data = data, nest = TRUE)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
```

# Select samples
```{r}
sample1_raw <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(intervention1) &
      AGE >= 19 & AGE <= 64 & # 19-64 years old
      OFFPOV == 1 # Income up to 100% FPL
  )

sample1 <- survey %>%
  subset(
    !is.na(intervention1) &
      AGE >= 19 & AGE <= 64 & # 19-64 years old
      OFFPOV == 1 # Income up to 100% FPL
  )

sample2_raw <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(intervention2) &
      AGE >= 19 & AGE <= 64 & # 19-64 years old
      OFFPOV == 1 # Income up to 100% FPL
  )

sample2 <- survey %>%
  subset(
    !is.na(intervention2) &
      AGE >= 19 & AGE <= 64 & # 19-64 years old
      OFFPOV == 1 # Income up to 100% FPL
  )

# Subset to pre-period
sample2_pre <- sample2 %>% subset(post == FALSE)

# Subset to post-period
sample2_post <- sample2 %>% subset(post == TRUE)
```

# Pre-post stats
```{r}
table(sample1_raw$intervention1, sample1_raw$post)

medicaid_post_sd <- svyby(~medicaid, ~intervention1 + post, design = sample1, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
medicaid_post_sd

uninsured_post_sd <- svyby(~uninsured, ~intervention1 + post, design = sample1, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
uninsured_post_sd

employed_post_sd <- svyby(~employed, ~intervention1 + post, design = subset(sample1, !is.na(employed)), FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
employed_post_sd

table(sample2_raw$intervention2, sample2_raw$post)

medicaid_post_south <- svyby(~medicaid, ~intervention2 + post, design = sample2, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
medicaid_post_south

uninsured_post_south <- svyby(~uninsured, ~intervention2 + post, design = sample2, FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
uninsured_post_south

employed_post_south <- svyby(~employed, ~intervention2 + post, design = subset(sample2, !is.na(employed)), FUN = svymean, vartype = "ci")
employed_post_south
```

# Calculate N's
```{r}
# Georgia vs. Alabama, Florida, Tennessee, Mississippi, South Carolina
## Unweighted N in pre period
total_tbl2_pre_u <- table(sample2_pre$variables$intervention2)
total_tbl2_pre_u

## Unweighted N in post period
total_tbl2_post_u <- table(sample2_post$variables$intervention2)
total_tbl2_post_u
```

# DID table
```{r}
gen_did_tbl <- function(outcome_var, survey_design, z_value = 1.96) {
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1) Intervention group
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subset design for the intervention group
  int_design <- subset(survey_design, intervention2 == TRUE)

  # Calculate pre vs. post means with covariance
  # So we can do a correct difference for the intervention group
  tbl_t <- svyby(
    formula = as.formula(paste0("~", outcome_var)),
    by = ~post,               
    design = int_design,
    FUN = svymean,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    covmat = TRUE,            # <--- ensures we get the full covariance matrix
    vartype = "ci"           
  )

  # Pre (FALSE) means
  pre_mean_t       <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == FALSE, outcome_var] * 100
  pre_ci_l_t       <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == FALSE, "ci_l"] * 100
  pre_ci_u_t       <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == FALSE, "ci_u"] * 100

  # Post (TRUE) means
  post_mean_t      <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == TRUE, outcome_var] * 100
  post_ci_l_t      <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == TRUE, "ci_l"] * 100
  post_ci_u_t      <- tbl_t[tbl_t$post == TRUE, "ci_u"] * 100

  # Use svycontrast to get the difference = Post (TRUE) - Pre (FALSE)
  diff_t <- svycontrast(
    tbl_t,
    quote(`TRUE` - `FALSE`)
  )
  # Coefficient (point estimate) is in coef(diff_t)
  diff_t_est <- coef(diff_t)[1] * 100   
  diff_t_se  <- SE(diff_t)[1]   * 100
  # 95% CI from confint()
  diff_t_ci  <- confint(diff_t) * 100  
  diff_t_ci_l <- diff_t_ci[1, 1]
  diff_t_ci_u <- diff_t_ci[1, 2]

  # Also get a p-value for (pre vs post) in the intervention group
  did_ttest_t <- svyttest(
    as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ post")),
    design = int_design
  )
  did_pval_t <- formatC(did_ttest_t$p.value, format = "f", digits = 4)


  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2) Control group
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subset design for the control group
  ctl_design <- subset(survey_design, intervention2 == FALSE)

  # Calculate pre vs. post means with covariance
  tbl_c <- svyby(
    formula = as.formula(paste0("~", outcome_var)),
    by = ~post,               
    design = ctl_design,
    FUN = svymean,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    covmat = TRUE,
    vartype = "ci"
  )

  # Pre (FALSE)
  pre_mean_c  <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == FALSE, outcome_var] * 100
  pre_ci_l_c  <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == FALSE, "ci_l"] * 100
  pre_ci_u_c  <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == FALSE, "ci_u"] * 100

  # Post (TRUE)
  post_mean_c <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == TRUE, outcome_var] * 100
  post_ci_l_c <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == TRUE, "ci_l"] * 100
  post_ci_u_c <- tbl_c[tbl_c$post == TRUE, "ci_u"] * 100

  # Difference in the control group
  diff_c <- svycontrast(
    tbl_c,
    quote(`TRUE` - `FALSE`)
  )
  diff_c_est <- coef(diff_c)[1] * 100
  diff_c_se  <- SE(diff_c)[1]   * 100
  diff_c_ci  <- confint(diff_c) * 100
  diff_c_ci_l <- diff_c_ci[1, 1]
  diff_c_ci_u <- diff_c_ci[1, 2]

  # p-value for control group
  did_ttest_c <- svyttest(
    as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ post")),
    design = ctl_design
  )
  did_pval_c <- formatC(did_ttest_c$p.value, format = "f", digits = 4)


  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) Print out results
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Intervention group
  cat("Intervention group:\n")
  cat(sprintf("Pre period mean: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              pre_mean_t, pre_ci_l_t, pre_ci_u_t))
  cat(sprintf("Post period mean: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              post_mean_t, post_ci_l_t, post_ci_u_t))
  cat(sprintf("Difference: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              diff_t_est, diff_t_ci_l, diff_t_ci_u))
  cat(sprintf("P value: %s\n\n", did_pval_t))

  # Control group
  cat("Control group:\n")
  cat(sprintf("Pre period mean: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              pre_mean_c, pre_ci_l_c, pre_ci_u_c))
  cat(sprintf("Post period mean: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              post_mean_c, post_ci_l_c, post_ci_u_c))
  cat(sprintf("Difference: %.1f (%.1f, %.1f)\n",
              diff_c_est, diff_c_ci_l, diff_c_ci_u))
  cat(sprintf("P value: %s\n\n", did_pval_c))
}

# GA v non-expansion 19-64
gen_did_tbl("medicaid", sample2)
gen_did_tbl("uninsured", sample2)
gen_did_tbl("employed", sample2)
```

# Unadjusted DID analysis
```{r}
# Medicaid
medicaid_unadj <- svyglm(medicaid ~ intervention2 * post, design = sample2)
summary(medicaid_unadj)
confint(medicaid_unadj)

# Uninsured
uninsured_unadj <- svyglm(uninsured ~ intervention2 * post, design = sample2)
summary(uninsured_unadj)
confint(uninsured_unadj)

# Employed
employed_unadj <- svyglm(employed ~ intervention2 * post, design = sample2)
summary(employed_unadj)
confint(employed_unadj)
```

# Adjusted DID analysis
```{r}
# Medicaid
medicaid_adj <- svyglm(medicaid ~ intervention2 * post + age_cat + sex_cat + race_cat + state_factor + date_factor, design = sample2)
summary(medicaid_adj)
confint(medicaid_adj)

# Uninsured
uninsured_adj <- svyglm(uninsured ~ intervention2 * post + age_cat + sex_cat + race_cat + state_factor + date_factor, design = sample2)
summary(uninsured_adj)
confint(uninsured_adj)

# Employed
employed_adj <- svyglm(employed ~ intervention2 * post + age_cat + sex_cat + race_cat + state_factor + date_factor, design = sample2)
summary(employed_adj)
confint(employed_adj)
```
